Business development performance becomes easier to understand when you can see the pipeline, the people, and the opportunities together.

Pipeline health provides the overall picture. Team attainment shows contributions against goals. Opportunity analysis helps explain what's behind the totals.

My Business Development Performance Power BI Kit brings these into three editable report pages: https://garrettsdevdesk.etsy.com/listing/4595453904/power-bi-business-development-dashboard

media.alt: Preview of the Business Development Performance Power BI Kit

posts:
A large pipeline can be reassuring until someone asks how much of it is likely to become actual business.

Total value, weighted value, stage distribution, and won business each reveal something different. Reviewing them together can help teams understand whether the pipeline supports their goals.

For business development managers and analysts, which metric do you find most useful when assessing pipeline health?
